purpose: Price-snapshot store: opening and closing numbers for every market we originate (side, total, moneyline), one row per market per game, open snapshot at origination and close snapshot at settlement.
sequence_rule: Origination order per market: (1) side/spread, (2) total, (3) moneyline. Each market is priced in that order before the next is opened.
coverage: Week 11: 13 games x 3 markets = 39 snapshot rows planned. Week 10: 14 games x 3 markets = 42 planned, 1 settled (WAS@NYG), remainder live/upcoming at snapshot time.
finding: The NFL publishes no betting lines, odds or prices anywhere on nfl.com or operations.nfl.com (re-checked 2026-11-15). Every market_open / market_close cell is therefore blank and flagged, never invented. model_fair_line and diff columns are originated model outputs, labeled as such, and are not prices you can bet at.
flags: MK-01 No official price source exists: all market open/close cells blank by policy.
MK-02 13 of 14 Week 10 games had no closing number at snapshot time because they had not been played; close is populated only at settlement.
MK-03 Market lines are third-party where shown elsewhere in this repo; this namespace publishes no third-party prices at all.
